subject: Error in running secr.fit with empty session

messages.author: 1e55c83b1f50d96a
messages.subject: Error in running secr.fit with empty session
parts:
Hi Murray and all,

I am running a multisession model using polygon detectors and have some empty sessions. The script is below and associated capture history and trap files are attached. 

edf <- read.table("gs_capt_dpp.txt", header=T)

tdf1 <- read.traps(file="amktge.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf2 <- read.traps(file="cbp1.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf3 <- read.traps(file="cbp2.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf4 <- read.traps(file="ecp1.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf5 <- read.traps(file="ecp2.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf6 <- read.traps(file="phcp.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf7 <- read.traps(file="pp1.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf8 <- read.traps(file="prp.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf9 <- read.traps(file="scp.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf10 <- read.traps(file="yp.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")
tdf11 <- read.traps(file="dpp.txt", detector="polygon", trapID="Detector")

catCH <- make.capthist(captures=edf, traps=list(tdf1,tdf2,tdf3,tdf4,tdf5,
tdf6,tdf7,tdf8,tdf9,tdf10,tdf11), fmt="XY", noccasions=4)

catmasks <- make.mask(traps(catCH), buffer=500, type='trapbuffer')

secr.fit(catCH, mask=catmasks, model=list(D~1, lambda0~1, sigma~1), verify=FALSE)

The script is similar to what Josh ran earlier but I get an error: 
Error in array(x, c(length(x), 1L), if (!is.null(names(x))) list(names(x),  :
  'data' must be of a vector type, was 'NULL'

The empty session was entered as such in the capture history file:
session ID occasion x y poly_ID
11 NONE 4 0 0 DPPgs

Was this incorrectly keyed in? I can't figure out how to rectify this short of omitting all empty sessions as Josh did earlier. It ran if this was done. Following his thread, you mentioned it ran on your computer with the empty sessions but with a pre-released version. I'm not sure if that was the difference! I'm using secr v4.4.8

Any help is much appreciated! Thanks.

Best,

Malcolm
